name: tracery
description: Streams Claude Code session, tool-call and subagent activity to a Tracery hub for live graph visualization.

hub_url.title: Tracery hub URL
hub_url.description: Base URL of the Tracery hub, e.g. https://tracery.example.com (no trailing slash needed).

api_key.title: Ingest API key
api_key.description: Tracery hub API key with the ingest role, sent as an Authorization: Bearer header. Leave empty for a local hub (one started with `npx @atriarch/tracery-hub` and no TRACERY_API_KEYS -- it runs with auth off).

workspace.title: Workspace
workspace.description: Tracery hub workspace to ingest events into.

include_prompts.title: Include prompt text
include_prompts.description: When enabled, forwards the full text of user prompts to the hub. Off by default: only the prompt's character count is sent.
